findings: In professional radiological workstations (Planmeca Romexis, OnDemand3D, Ez3D-i, KaVo), all 4 viewports (Axial, Coronal, Sagittal, and 3D Volume) must be visible simultaneously on screen at all times without hiding any viewport behind tabs.

Cornerstone3D ViewportType.VOLUME_3D uses VTK volume actors under the hood. Its setProperties({ preset }) API natively accepts both built-in preset strings (e.g. 'CT-Bone') and custom ViewportPreset objects.
To avoid mouse binding conflicts with MPR CrosshairsTool on Primary LMB, the 3D volume viewport uses its own dedicated ToolGroup (volume3dToolGroupIdRef).
Directly rendering CornerstoneVolume3DViewport in the 4th quadrant eliminates all tab state, unneeded resize effects on tab switch, and DOM wrapper bloat.

Window resizing and container dimension changes are actively observed via ResizeObserver and window 'resize' listener, triggering renderingEngine.resize() and viewport.render() to prevent aspect ratio distortion or canvas stretch.
